verdict.rationale: Docs describe a dedicated Sandbox/Test Drive plan with unlimited, non-billable access to all API endpoints, plus test banks (FinBanks), test payroll (FinPayroll), and testing personas representing sample users — clearly separated from production data. This directly supports safe sandbox testing without touching production. Missing for 10: no explicit statement that sandbox data is fully synthetic/isolated from production systems, and no independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
